title: Region
description: Several districts in one continuous coordinate space, assembled by SimRegion.generate. docs/24's region, built at the size the measurement in docs/23's record allows rather than at the size docs/24 asks for -- the owner's 2026-09-09 call, and the docs/24 amendment that goes with it explains why the gap between districts is a seam rather than the 300-500 m that document argues for.

id.description: Stable namespaced id. Permanent once shipped; SimRegion.generate selects on it.

name.description: What the place is called out loud. Prose, not an enum.

cellTiles.description: The side of one district in tiles. 256 is docs/24's district and the size every balance band, the survivability validator and the harness were measured against, which is why the owner's extent decision kept it. **This is the dial to turn if the region is over budget** -- the measurement in docs/23's record has no headroom at 2x256, so lowering this is expected to be the first response to a real run being slow, and it needs no code change.

seamTiles.description: Tiles of road between adjacent districts. docs/24 argues for 300-500 m and this ships far under it -- see the amendment there. 0 is legal and means the districts' walls touch, with their connection-point openings meeting directly; the assembler carves no seam at all in that case and the region gate's flood lane is what proves the cells still join.

cells.description: Which district sits where, on a grid of cell coordinates. Order in this array does not matter -- SimRegion.cells_of sorts by (y, x), for the reason templates_of sorts by id: nothing the assembler does may depend on the order content happened to be written in.

district.description: The district type generated into this cell. Named in the cell's own seed derivation, so changing it re-rolls this cell and leaves its neighbours untouched.
